result.rationale: embed.js adds `if (discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1) { return; }` for postMessage validation. Substring matching of origins is a known-spoofable pattern: an origin like `http://<host>.evil.com` or `http://evil.com?<host>` contains the discourse host as a substring, so the check passes and an attacker page embedding this iframe could send discourse-resize messages. The code is verbatim in the diff and the mechanism (indexOf vs strict equality) is real, though impact is limited to controlling iframe height.
